audit.why: Pyke flips the lane hard at level 2 with charged Bone Skewer and stealth/dash follow-up, holding pressure through 3-5 and the level-6 execute reset; Milio only reclaims it once items land — matches content win[] and packet.levelChart.

Pyke spikes at level 2 (charged Q + E/W) and level 6 (Death From Below execute+reset, CD 100/85/70s); Milio's counter-spike is first item (sustained shields) and full item power (R cleanse breaks his all-in pattern).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-6].side all said 'Skill' while content win[] (already correct, matching packet.levelChart) has Milio/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Pyke/Milio — a page-facing contradiction across all 7 rows. Missing interactions (Pyke's P bypasses stacking resistances; his Q is a channel your R interrupts) weren't surfaced.
audit.why: regression-check.js fails the champion on any full/content disagreement; the packet's own defect note (levelChart looks Pyke-heavy vs 53.24% overall Milio win rate) is resolved by kit facts — Pyke wins lane, Milio's kit answers in teamfights, which is exactly what content already states.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[].side to match win[] with rewritten .why grounded in the kit. Folded the resistance-bypass and channel-interrupt facts into breakdown.cooldowns and report[8] itemization.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: Save your shield for the caught ally, not the poke — a spent charge before the hook lands does nothing.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Chasing his reset through fog trades vision for a kill he's already banked gold from — decline it.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke's Bone Skewer (Q) cools down 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and is a channel — your Breath of Life (R) cancels it outright. - Death From Below (R) resets on execute, cooldown 100/85/70s. - Bank your R for the fight it swings, not a habit.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. His passive punishes HP stacking; add anti-heal early.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the rebound catches the second body; bot stands in pairs.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: your Q poke and Cozy Campfire sustain out-tempo Pyke's early presence.

edits.before: E-shields begin: two charges of trade insurance; count them like summoners.
edits.after: Charged Bone Skewer flips it — Pyke hooks and bursts before your shield lands.

edits.before: Full kit: the campfire's range gift means your duo out-ranges theirs standing still.
edits.after: Full kit favors Pyke: his Q range and roam threat punish any pushed-up positioning.

edits.before: Chip and warm the margins — the burn passive taxes every shielded trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay Pyke's: pick pressure and cooldowns keep you on the back foot.

edits.before: Breath of Life online — their CC chain comp now answers to one cleansing button.
edits.after: Death From Below executes and resets — his level-6 all-in is the dominant threat.

edits.before: First item: the fire compounds and the range zone decides every poke war.
edits.after: First item still Pyke's: his burst-and-vanish outpaces your single-item peel.

edits.before: Late Milio un-CCs teamfights: cleanse the chain, range the siege, and warm the carry through everything.
edits.after: At 2+ items your range buff, Q peel and R cleanse hard-counter his dive-and-execute pattern completely.

notes: Full-layer chart was a blanket 'Skill' template disagreeing with the already-correct content win[]/whys[] (which matches packet.levelChart exactly: Pyke wins levels 2-6/first-item, Milio wins L1 and 2+ items).
